skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and explain the nature of environmental monitoring.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Role and Position of Environmental Monitoring
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Grasp the role and position of environmental monitoring in resource management and environmental management.
Understand how to apply environmental monitoring methodology in practical environmental management activities.
Design a program for environmental monitoring for soil, water, air components.
Master sampling techniques for environmental monitoring.
Learn analytical methods for environmental parameters.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Evaluation and Reporting of Environmental Monitoring Results
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Learn evaluation and reporting methods for environmental monitoring results.
Develop independent work skills, self-study, and creativity.
Possess teamwork skills, self-management, and responsibility.
